name: mlai-marketing-docs-review
description: Isolated MLAI marketing/docs review and Next.js source candidate; not a production migration.

scripts.typecheck:core: tsc --noEmit --strict --target ES2022 --module commonjs --lib ES2022,DOM lib/content.ts lib/search.ts lib/reading.ts lib/dom.ts lib/chrome-ui.ts lib/search-ui.ts lib/filter-ui.ts lib/reading-ui.ts lib/brief-ui.ts lib/interactions.ts
scripts.check:review: npm run typecheck:core && npm run check:syntax && npm run docs:generate && npm run preview:build && npm run test && node scripts/check-links.cjs
scripts.check:framework: node scripts/framework-preflight.cjs && npm run typecheck && npm run build
